text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with number y.
Plate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
FromNumber(x, y) ::: x's plate begins with number y.

Premises:
∀x (Plate(x) → FromNumber(x, 34)) ::: All vehicle plates in Istanbul begin with 34.
∀x (¬FromNumber(x, 34) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not beginning with 34 are not from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(Joe'sPlate) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(Tom'sPlate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
(∀x (BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34))) ::: If a license begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.

Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(Tom'sPlate) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
